completedInBranch: P0 chart polling/refresh and chart-series lifecycle repairs
Canonical live/backtest signal evaluator and higher-timeframe fail-closed behavior
GitHub Actions with frozen dependency installation, Prisma generation, lint, strict typecheck, Bun tests, offline market-data CLI smoke tests and production build
Deterministic tests for indicators, causal resampling, next-open fills, HTF gating, market identity, source normalization, dataset hashes and tamper detection
Canonical instrument metadata separating broker CFD, OTC spot metal, exchange futures, continuous futures and tokenized gold
Pinned Dukascopy 1.51.1 download orchestrator for XAUUSD and USATECH CFD with bid/ask isolation, conservative pacing, retry controls, local cache and explicit handling of normal empty sessions
UTC CSV importer with SHA-256 raw/normalized hashes, immutable dataset revisions, OHLC validation, duplicate/gap diagnostics and no synthetic bars
Dataset catalog and explicit loader that replays the original CSV, recreates normalized bars and checks data-class identity, quote side, volume metadata, quality labels and dataset hashes
Authenticated dataset catalogue and paginated verified-bar APIs
Chart-panel selector for explicit PASS-labelled local historical revisions; exact dataset response identity is required before bars are displayed
Chart desk defaults to PASS-labelled local revisions and exposes a deliberate REVIEW opt-in; REVIEW requests explicitly set allowReview=true and still pass full source/hash validation
Immutable local historical chart sources refetch only on manual refresh or a long safety interval; live provider charts keep their shorter polling cadence

Optional per-chart confirmed swing structure overlay: unique swing pivots only become available after right-side closed-bar confirmation; BOS/CHoCH markers appear on actual break candles and are never backdated

Structure engine sorts and deduplicates input bars to match chart candle normalization; fixtures cover confirmation delay, CHoCH direction changes, no future-data repaint, equal-pivot suppression and duplicate/out-of-order input

Optional experimental current-rate monitor: pinned dukascopy-node 1.51.1 installed in isolated local runtime with separate lock; worker polls tick plus separate bid/ask candles; writes atomic local snapshots; supports Ctrl+C and one-shot mode
Authenticated monitor snapshot API and chart-desk state/spread display; monitor status remains separate from the chart's historical/provider candle source
Monitor normalization separates closed/forming bars, retains bid/ask OHLC separately, computes top-of-book spread from paired ticks, and classifies NO_TICK/FRESH/STALE

Operation capability policy distinguishes PASS/REVIEW chart and side-specific signal research from backtesting; single-side bid/ask history cannot unlock strategy backtests, paper execution or live routing
Chart data source is persisted per panel by exact immutable dataset ID; changing back to provider feed clears the old local chart data immediately

Observed prior available UTC calendar-date high/low overlay: uses only observed closed bars, skips missing dates without synthetic fill, labels provenance date and observed bar count, and does not claim exchange-session semantics
